text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um, maybe we should head back? It's, like, kinda getting cold…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: On the contrary, it's as hot and stuffy as ever… and about time you learned to face your fears.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That you would forget your candy at the bus stop in the first place is just… preposterous. I wouldn't bet they were left untouched, but we should check nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, you were definitely the wrong person to ask for help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Did y-you h-hear something just now?! What if it's a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's not. Ghosts don't exist. …It's coming from over there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle…
Hiyaaaa! Hoiyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Take that, you stupid ghost! You won't be disturbing this plane on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Time to test whether the Kongo Yaegaki style of fighting can even best a specter! …Hm? Do I sense this thing is of the living?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you trying to kill us or something?! I thought my heart was gonna stop for good!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Apologies. Bamboo was spurred into action by the ghost, so I followed her lead.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And I found the troublemakers after all! I knew it was a good idea to go on patrol!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What are you two doing out so late? Wait, are you the Dragger in disguise?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The Dragger? That doesn't sound real at all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's legit! There's a rumor going around that after dark, you'll hear this shuffling sound around here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sound is coming from the shore. This time, perhaps it really is a ghost. Let us go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud… Rustle!
Marvelooooous!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaagh! It's heeeere!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Looks like we've got some new customers. ♪ I knew adding more bamboo slides was the answer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wowiee! ☆ Our noodle slide evening extravaganza just got more marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: L-look at how meticulously they've weaved the bamboo… It's a work of art.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So this is the true identity of the Dragger! You have been shuffling bamboo around night after night to make this noodle slide contraption.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This isn't the time to talk! Their actions have disrupted the peace, and therefore this must be dismantled!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But we got permission from the director. ♪ Besides, we have to serve our hungry customers.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That fifth person in your group is practically drooling over the noodles. ★ Take a look, right behind you…

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Huh?
